commands: for f in retrospective-weekly review init implement receiving-code-review; do printf '%s %s\n' "$(wc -c < skills/$f/SKILL.md)" "skills/$f/SKILL.md"; done; echo "---lines---"; for f in phase-1-setup phase-2-implement phase-3-review phase-4-documentation; do printf '%s %s\n' "$(wc -c < skills/implement/phases/$f.md)" "$f"; done; echo "SKILL implement: $(wc -c < skills/implement/SKILL.md)"

for f in skills/retrospective-weekly/SKILL.md skills/review/SKILL.md skills/init/SKILL.md skills/implement/SKILL.md skills/receiving-code-review/SKILL.md skills/create-issue/references/step-3-6-audit.md; do printf "%8d  %s\n" "$(wc -c < "$f" 2>/dev/null)" "$f"; done; echo "--- disable-model-invocation ---"; grep -l "disable-model-invocation" skills/*/SKILL.md 2>/dev/null
for f in skills/*/SKILL.md; do printf "%8d  %s\n" "$(wc -c < "$f")" "$f"; done | sort -rn

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
